title: Amazon blocks Meta’s Muse AI agent

reason: Reputable media report (The Verge/GeekWire) of an AI industry business event: Amazon blocking Meta's Muse AI agent from shopping on its platform, a corporate access/enforcement dispute between companies, not a government regulatory action.
